tests: a real repository above os.tmpdir() leaves the removed-.git, never-a-repository and GIT-stripped no-repository arms green, because git's ceiling stops discovery as the capture records

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of git rev-parse --show-toplevel, captured 2026-09-24 with git 2.43.0 against a scratch repository with one commit laid out as test/git-ceiling.test.ts stages it: with no GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES a plain directory inside it discovers the ancestor (exit 0, <lab>), with the ceiling at the ancestor it discovers nothing (exit 128, not a git repository), and a repository initialised below the ceiling is still found (exit 0, <lab>/ctx). The test re-runs the same probes live and compares status, stdout and stderr with the record, the lab path spelled <lab>, before running the three victims under a real ancestor repository.
